question_text: What in your view are the reasons for population explosion, especially in India?

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Better health care
steps.why: When fewer people die each year but the same number are born, the population grows even with no change in birth rate.
common_mistakes: Blaming a rising birth rate alone.
steps.memory_tip: More people surviving, not more people being born.

steps.label: Falling death rates
steps.why: Mothers and infants were once the likeliest to die, so improving their survival changes the population fastest.
common_mistakes: Giving the abbreviations without their full forms.
Naming only one of the two rates.
steps.memory_tip: MMR is for mothers, IMR is for infants.
lines: 3. Decline in the maternal mortality rate,

lines.text: 4. Decline in the infant mortality rate, IMR

insider_note: The answer is about the death rate falling, not the birth rate rising. Name MMR and IMR — those two abbreviations are what the examiner looks for.
